qualification.lifecycle_scope: verified release snapshot of MainPID and recorded PID/start descendants; no new process query by report generator

scope: finite FP32 fixed-model/request per-card-budget batch search; headless backbone, not language-model TTFT; no new A/B/D maximum or training/recovery qualification

plan.scope: fixed-model FP32 short cached-request batch throughput search; supplementary C/32/48, no new A/B/D maximum claim
plan.search_rule: reuse historical points; calibrate B8 then geometric growth up to 4x with conservative linear peak forecasts; refine budget boundary to adjacent integers when safe; stop after two <=2% gains or a bracketed budget boundary; retain failures; best means best observed within budget
plan.boundary_rule: allow one neighboring predicted budget breach only below 54GiB allocated and 60GiB reserved forecast; reject actual budget failures from winner; no repeated hardware OOM search
plan.confirmation_rule: new winner and a necessary nearby competitor use full samples; reuse existing full-sample winners with unchanged implementation when appropriate; compare overlap batch separately from per-budget winner
plan.placement: Tide region/per_device; Transformer contiguous complete layers; host_stage; no replicas

plan.scope: fixed-model FP32 short cached-request batch throughput search; supplementary C/32/48, no new A/B/D maximum claim

plan.boundary_rule: allow one neighboring predicted budget breach only below 54GiB allocated and 60GiB reserved forecast; reject actual budget failures from winner; no repeated hardware OOM search
plan.confirmation_rule: new winner and a necessary nearby competitor use full samples; reuse existing full-sample winners with unchanged implementation when appropriate; compare overlap batch separately from per-budget winner
